caption:
Want Allah's help to stay steadfast today?

Allah promises the believers that if they stand up for Him, He will help them and make their steps firm. Start this morning by putting Him first.

Surah Muhammad 47:7

Pick one small way to stand up for Allah today

#steadfast #istiqamah #morningreminder #quranreels
